verdict.rationale: Poke's docs explicitly cover email (read, search, draft) and calendar (scheduling, availability) as built-in capabilities. They also describe a general integrations/recipes system and direct MCP-server connections that let Poke 'access information and perform actions across apps' through conversation. However, no cloud drive connector (e.g. Google Drive, Dropbox) is named, so drive search would rely on finding or building a recipe or MCP server. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented cloud-drive integration, details on how connected data is searched and used in answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
